title: 九分机经 Part 1 听力逐题审阅小批
usePolicy: 两份完整 Part 1 各含10题；答案是可追溯的项目参考，不称官方答案。可作为练习，隔离验证后可作部分短测；不作为已核实整卷测试。

unitDifficulty.reason: 单一笔记填空但包含路线顺序、时间定位、对比转折和同义替换；转写证据对每题都给出明确答案，编辑难度按信息处理要求判为3/5。
unitDifficulty.basis: transcript and task only; audio delivery difficulty unknown

questions.evidenceQuote: And also, at one point when we stopped for a picnic, I was lying in a field looking up and saw a huge flock of birds. They were obviously migrating.
questions.explanation: The transcript says “a huge flock of birds”; this directly supplies the plural noun after “large numbers of”.

questions.evidenceQuote: Oh, and another thing, you don't stay in a hotel. You stay in a tent, so you don't have to come back to town in the evening.
questions.explanation: The speaker contrasts hotel with tent and then confirms the latter as the accommodation.

questions.evidenceQuote: Where you're really heading for is the mountains, and when you set out, you can only see them in the far distance.
questions.explanation: Valleys are mentioned as the morning route, but the stated final destination is the mountains.

questions.prompt: Evening activity: chance to have a ____
questions.blankContext: Evening activity: chance to have a ____
questions.evidenceQuote: But on that first evening, when you've been riding all day, you get the opportunity to go for a swim, and you really enjoy that.
questions.explanation: “Go for a swim” completes the evening activity; the answer is the noun after “a”.

questions.prompt: Explore the valley and have lunch by a ____
questions.blankContext: Explore the valley and have lunch by a ____
questions.evidenceQuote: At the end of it, there's a waterfall. It's an amazing place to stop for lunch.
questions.explanation: The waterfall is introduced as the place where the group stops for lunch.

questions.evidenceQuote: And in the afternoon, there's a trip that goes to a cave. You can even ride into it.
questions.explanation: The afternoon destination is explicitly named as a cave.

questions.evidenceQuote: It was okay, actually, but what you've got to watch for is that you don't have any trouble with your back. Riding can really aggravate that.
questions.explanation: The speaker corrects the possible knee concern and identifies back problems as the relevant risk.

questions.evidenceQuote: So make sure you have walking boots, not just normal riding boots.
questions.explanation: The required footwear is walking boots; “normal riding boots” is explicitly contrasted.

questions.evidenceQuote: When I was looking at the website, I saw that if I register online, I can get a discount.
questions.explanation: Registering online is the transcript’s equivalent of booking online and is followed by the benefit “a discount”.

questions.prompt: Inform your ____ company about the type of holiday booked
questions.blankContext: Inform your ____ company about the type of holiday booked
questions.evidenceQuote: you have to make sure that your insurance company know that you're going on an adventure trip to make sure that you're covered in case anything happens.
questions.explanation: The company to notify is the insurance company, not the boss mentioned immediately beforehand.

questions.evidenceQuote: Oh, it's E-L-S-I-N-O-R-E, Elsinore.
questions.explanation: The place name is first queried and then spelled out and repeated, so the project reference answer is Elsinore.

questions.evidenceQuote: Actually, it's easier to reach me by my cellphone number. It's zero double seven, eight, nine, six, two, four, five.
questions.explanation: zero double seven means 0-7-7, followed by 896245. The prior 007896245 was a normalization error. Original audio still requires listening.

questions.prompt: worked at the ____ as a lifeguard
questions.blankContext: worked at the ____ as a lifeguard
questions.evidenceQuote: I also worked part-time as a rescue diver for a local beach last summer.
questions.explanation: The location is a local beach; “rescue diver” identifies the role.

questions.evidenceQuote: I'm good at diving. You know, my previous job requires training in that.

questions.prompt: Need a certificate: it expires in ____
questions.blankContext: Need a certificate: it expires in ____
questions.evidenceQuote: but mine is about to expire in November. Oh, wait, let me check. It's a month earlier in October.

questions.evidenceQuote: I can work on Saturday mornings then.

questions.blankContext: He can start to work at ____ o'clock.

questions.evidenceQuote: I heard it on radio this morning while driving. I wouldn't say I like reading newspapers.
